title: Ordering a birthday cake
instructions: Elena kızı için doğum günü pastası sipariş ediyor. Tat, yazı, boyut ve teslim gününe dikkat et.

script.speaker: elena
script.text: Hello. I'd like to order a birthday cake for my daughter.

script.speaker: baker
script.text: Of course. What kind of cake would you like?

script.speaker: elena
script.text: Chocolate, please. But she doesn't like nuts, so no nuts at all.

script.speaker: baker
script.text: No problem. How many people is it for?

script.speaker: baker
script.text: Then a medium cake is enough. Would you like any writing on it?

script.speaker: elena
script.text: On Saturday morning. The party starts at two.

script.speaker: baker
script.text: It'll be ready on Friday afternoon. It's thirty-five pounds.

questions.prompt: What kind of cake does Elena want?
questions.evidence: Chocolate, please. But she doesn't like nuts
